//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> Infinite Trading -> Config

Enable Infinite Trading.//: Whether Infinite Trading is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart. Do not disable a mod that adds blocks or items to an existing world, they will be removed.

wanderingTraderInfiniteTrades.//: When enabled, the trades of the wandering trader will never lock up.

villagerInfiniteTrades.//: When enabled, the trades of villagers will never lock up.

fallbackInfiniteTrades.//: If abstract villagers that are not a villager or wandering trader, from other mods, should have infinite trades.
